notes.title: Update to version 1.6.6
notes.content:
*Bug fixes.
*JUTSU's attack power is increased.
*Reduce the number of enemies.
*Decreased strength and attack power of the boss.
*Increase in recovery items.
*Tutorial modifications.
*Added zoom in/out function to the gallery.

notes.title: Update to version 1.5.6
notes.content:
*Two additions to the gallery.
*Added game over gallery.
 You can enter from :2 on the right side of the gallery.

notes.title: Update to version 1.4.6
notes.content:
Added invincibility mode.
It detracts from the appeal of the game.
Please use this mode only if you are unable to clear the game using EASY mode.

notes.title: Update to version 1.4.4
notes.content:
* Enhanced some animations.
* Added sexy voice to Gallery.

Enhanced animations for the main character, some enemies, and boss events.
Gallery has longer load times.

notes.title: mini-update　Release of Ver. 1.1.3
notes.content:
Full screen view by maximizing the browser.

It will take a little longer to add the Gallery.

notes.title: mini-update Release of Ver. 1.1.2
notes.content:
* Eliminated the phenomenon of slow operation when a USB controller is not connected.
* Fixed bug in stage select.
* Weakened the last boss in EASY mode.

notes.title: Update Release of Ver 1.1.1
notes.content:
We apologize for the inconvenience.
We have updated to version 1.1.1 today.

≪Updated content≫
-Add a tutorial.
-Changes to the battle system.
-Adjust enemy defense, strength, speed, and number.
-Decrease in overall difficulty.
-Strengthen EASY mode.
-Add a gallery.
-Easing of gallery release conditions.
-Fixed a bug that occurred when falling.
-Fixed JUTSU and stage selection bugs that could not be used.

≪Future Plans≫
-Bug fixes, screenshot support.
-Add a gallery.
-Added game over illustrations.

Please review and rate the store page if you like.
The more motivated you are, the more galleries you will have.
